camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnUserDomainsByFunc --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyuji4b6r400' --MatchType exact_match --DomainName 'example.com' --PageNumber 1 --FuncId 7 --FuncFilter config
description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnUserDomainsByFunc operation to query all DCDN domain names that are associated with your account and have a specific feature configured. The feature is specified by FuncId
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnUserDomainsByFunc通过FuncId查询用户名下所有配置了指定功能的DCDN域名
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-user-domains-by-func --func-id 7 --func-filter config --domain-name example.com --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --resource-group-id rg-acfmyuji4b6r400 --match-type exact_match --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnUserDomainsByFunc

parameters.help_en: The ID of the feature. To find the ID, search for the feature by name in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410622.html document. For example, the ID of the back-to-origin HOST configuration feature (set_req_host_header) is 18
parameters.help_zh:
功能ID，您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410622.html文档，根据功能名称搜索查询。
例如：配置回源HOST（set_req_host_header）功能ID为18
parameters.name: func_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the feature specified by FuncId is enabled.

config: enabled.

unconfig: not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开通funcid功能。

config：开通。
unconfig：未开通
parameters.name: func_filter

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The default value is 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh:
页码，默认值：1。
取值范围：1~100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of domain names to return on each page. The default value is 20. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh:
单页显示域名的数量，默认值：20。
取值范围：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The query type. The default value is exact_match. Valid values:

fuzzy_match: fuzzy query.

exact_match: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型，支持以下2种类型，默认为精确查询。

fuzzy_match：模糊查询。
exact_match：精确查询
parameters.name: match_type

PageData.description_en: An array of PageData objects that contain the status information of the accelerated domain names
PageData.description_zh: 由PageData组成的数组格式，返回加速域名的状态信息

Cname.description_en: The CNAME that is assigned to the accelerated domain name

Description.description_en: The reason why the review failed

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

online: enabled.

offline: disabled.

configuring: configuring.

configure_failed: configuration failed.

checking: under review.

check_failed: review failed
DomainStatus.description_zh:
加速域名状态。取值：

online：启用。
offline：停用。
configuring：配置中。
configure_failed：配置失败。
checking：正在审核。
check_failed：审核失败

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the accelerated domain name was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the accelerated domain name was last modified

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Source.description_en: The information about the origin server

Content.description_en: The address of the origin server

Port.description_en: The port of the origin server

Type.description_en: The type of the origin server

Weight.description_en: The weight of the origin server for back-to-origin routing

SslProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTPS is enabled. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off: disabled
SslProtocol.description_zh:
HTTPS开关。取值：

on：已开启。
off：未开启

PageSize.description_en: The number of domain names returned on the current page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of domain names
